title: Durable Medical Equipment Rentals Ordering Documentation and Authorization Requirements by Payment Class
content:
The documents that must stand behind a Durable Medical Equipment Rentals item - the face-to-face examination, the written order, the certificate of medical necessity and its recertification, the Durable Medical Equipment Authorization, the kinds of supplier allowed and signed proof of delivery - are set by the item's payment class as follows.

## A. Clinical and order documentation

| Payment class | Face-to-face examination must precede the order | Days before the order within which the examination must fall | Written order on file before delivery | Certificate of medical necessity required | Months after which medical necessity must be recertified |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Inexpensive or Routinely Purchased Equipment | No | 0 (not applicable) | No | No | 0 (none) |
| Capped Rental Equipment | No | 0 (not applicable) | No | No | 0 (none) |
| Continuous Positive Airway Pressure Equipment | Yes | 183 | Yes | No | 0 (none) |
| Power Mobility Device | Yes | 183 | Yes | No | 0 (none) |
| Oxygen and Oxygen Equipment | Yes | 30 | Yes | Yes | 12 |
| Frequently Serviced Equipment | Yes | 183 | Yes | No | 0 (none) |
| Customized Equipment | Yes | 183 | Yes | No | 0 (none) |

## B. Authorization, supplier and delivery

| Payment class | TRICARE Prime enrollees need a Durable Medical Equipment Authorization | TRICARE Select and premium-based plan enrollees need a Durable Medical Equipment Authorization | Kinds of supplier allowed | Signed proof of delivery required before the first rental month is paid |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Inexpensive or Routinely Purchased Equipment | Yes | No | Network facility or supplier; non-network participating provider | Yes |
| Capped Rental Equipment | Yes | No | Network facility or supplier; non-network participating provider | Yes |
| Continuous Positive Airway Pressure Equipment | Yes | No | Network facility or supplier; non-network participating provider | Yes |
| Power Mobility Device | Yes | Yes | Network facility or supplier; non-network participating provider | Yes |
| Oxygen and Oxygen Equipment | Yes | No | Network facility or supplier; non-network participating provider | Yes |
| Frequently Serviced Equipment | Yes | Yes | Network facility or supplier; non-network participating provider | Yes |
| Customized Equipment | Yes | Yes | Network facility or supplier; non-network participating provider | Yes |

The two supplier kinds are those of the TRICARE West provider directory: a network facility or supplier, and a non-network provider that participates, that is, accepts assignment on the claim.

## C. Class entry conditions

| Payment class | Entry conditions of the class |
|---|---|
| Inexpensive or Routinely Purchased Equipment | The item is for home use |
| Capped Rental Equipment | The item is for home use; a written order is on file before the first rental month is paid |
| Continuous Positive Airway Pressure Equipment | A face-to-face examination within 183 days; a sleep study documented |
| Power Mobility Device | A face-to-face examination within 183 days; a mobility limitation documented |
| Oxygen and Oxygen Equipment | A face-to-face examination within 30 days; a certificate of medical necessity; a qualifying blood gas or saturation result |
| Frequently Serviced Equipment | A face-to-face examination within 183 days; a life-sustaining need documented |
| Customized Equipment | A face-to-face examination within 183 days; individual measurements documented |

## Points read from the tables

- Under TRICARE Prime, every class needs a Durable Medical Equipment Authorization.
- Under TRICARE Select and the premium-based plans, only Power Mobility Device, Frequently Serviced Equipment and Customized Equipment need one.
- Oxygen and Oxygen Equipment alone needs a certificate of medical necessity, recertified after 12 months, and its face-to-face window is 30 days rather than 183.
- Signed proof of delivery is required before the first rental month is paid in all seven classes, and the same two supplier kinds are allowed in all seven.
